verses.text: Ha winhaj Samuel kelemxo winh, hanheja' smunlaj winh t'a skajnub' Jehová t'a yalanh smandar winhaj sacerdote Elí. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' nib'ab'il slolonel Jehová, yujto manh komonok sch'ox sb'a t'a junok mach t'a wayichal.
Haxo winhaj Elí chi' wan yixtax yol sat winh, maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh. Ay jun ak'wal ayik waynak winh t'a yol scuarto,
haxo winhaj Samuel chi' sway t'a junxo scuarto t'a slak'anil kajnub' b'aj ayek' te' skaxa'il strato Jehová Dios. Ayik ayto sakb'i, ayto och sk'ak'al candil,
ix awaj Jehová t'a winhaj Samuel chi', ix yalani: --Samuel, xchi. --Oy, xchi winh.

Ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi', ix yalan winh: --Ina hin tik, ¿tas yuj tzin awtej? xchi winh. --Malaj hin tzach wawtej, ixik b'at ek'anxi jichan, xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Ix b'at ek'xi jichan winh b'aj waynak chi'.

Ix awajxi Jehová t'a winh: --Samuel, xchi. Ix k'ex wan winh, ix b'atxi winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi', ix yalanxi winh: --Ina hin tik, ¿tas yuj tzin awtej? xchi winh. --Ach wuninal, malaj hach tzach wawtej. B'at wayanhxi, xchi winhaj Elí chi'.
Ha winhaj Samuel chi' manto yojtakok Jehová winh, yujto manta b'aj slolon jun'elok t'a winh.

Haxo t'a yoxelal ix awajxi Jehová t'a winh, ix k'ex wa'an winh, ix b'atxi winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elí chi': --Ina hin tik, yujto ha hach tik tzin awtej, xchi winh. Ichato chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj Elí to ha Jehová tz'awtan winh kelem chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ixik, b'at ek'anhxi jichan. Tato ay mach tzach awtan jun'elxo, tzach tak'wi icha tik: Lolonanh Mamin, tik swab' ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xa chi, xchi winhaj Elí chi'. Yuj chi', ix b'at ek'xi jichan winh b'aj waynak chi'.

Ix k'och Jehová t'a slak'anil winh, ix awaj t'a winh icha ix aj yawtan winh t'a juntak el chi', ix yalani: --Samuel, Samuel, xchi. --Lolonanh Mamin, tik swab' ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, xchi winhaj Samuel chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Ay jun tas ol hin k'ulej t'a chonhab' Israel tik, ol te somchajcha'anh heb' anima yab'ani.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ol elk'och masanil ix walkan t'a yib'anh winhaj Elí yet' masanil yinhtilal.

Toxo ix wal yab' winh to ol wak' syahelal heb' yinhtilal winh t'a jun'elnhej, yujto yojtakxo winh tas chukal sk'ulej heb' winh yuninal winh chi', ix hin spatikejel heb' winh ha hin Dios hin tik, palta maj skach jab'ok heb' winh yuninal winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix wak' hin ti' to ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elí chi', malaj junok silab', ma junok ofrenda syal stupanel smul heb', xchi t'a winh.
Ix ek'xi jichan winhaj Samuel chi', haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix sjakan skajnub' Jehová winh. Ix xiw winh yalan juntzanh chi' t'a winhaj Elí chi'.
Palta ix awtaj winh yuj winhaj Elí chi', icha tik: --Samuel, xchi winh. --Ina hin tik, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Elí chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach? Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol to malaj junok tas ol ha k'ub'ejel t'ayin. A'okab' Jehová chi' ol ak'an ha yahelal tato ay junok ol ha k'ub'ejel t'ayin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Samuel smasanil t'a winh, malaj wal jab'ok tas to maj yal winh. Ix yalan winhaj Elí chi' icha tik: --Ha wal Jehová ix halani, elokab'k'och tas wach' t'a sat, xchi winh.
Yakb'an wan sk'ib' winhaj Samuel chi', ha Jehová aynhejoch yet' winh. Masanil lolonel syal winh tz'elnhejk'ochi.
Yuj chi', masanil heb' anima t'a yol smakb'en Israel, syalelk'ochi skot t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba, ix nachajel yuj heb' to ha winhaj Samuel chi' yel schekab' ton wal Jehová yaj winh.
Ix sch'oxnhej sb'a Jehová chi' t'a winh t'a Silo, ix lolon t'a winh.
